CheckTitle: Ensure Assignments of Substantial Access to Fusion Users Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion pod HCM REST with Basic Auth (Connections page): userAccounts with userAccountRoles
Description: Assignments of privileges that change application behaviour, create or approve transactions or expose sensitive data should be monitored.
Risk: Such privileges remove the usual separation of duties and oversight.
AuditProcedure: Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 4085, 4096, 4097, 9361.

Steps: Remove unwanted assignments or monitor the users' transactions.
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.

Notes: Reads every Fusion user's role assignments from the HCM REST API. Substantial access = HCM Data Loader / integration-specialist and IT security roles (CIS examples 4085, 4096, 4097, 9361), matched by role name; SUBSTANTIAL_ROLE_PATTERNS overrides the list. FAIL when such a role was granted in the last ROLE_REVIEW_DAYS (default 30); otherwise PASS, with holders listed for review.
